meta.notes: The call a goat horn plays. sound_event is the vanilla Seek call, named by its sound event id. One blow lasts 5 seconds and the horn then cools down as long (use_duration); players hear it 256 blocks away (range). A goat horn plays it when its minecraft:instrument component names msm_examples:mountain_echo: /give @s minecraft:goat_horn[minecraft:instrument="msm_examples:mountain_echo"].
